dataset_provenance: repository-schema synthetic; no verified production cardinalities
additional_sampling: No automatic extension for failures or instability. After diagnosis/fix at most one explicitly selected two-batch rerun in a new run identity; unresolved uncertainty goes to H1.
arrival_policy: Source admission unchanged; any pre-ingress pacing/setup waits recorded separately, never silently disable/reset rate limiting
timer: CLOCK_MONOTONIC nanoseconds within one Linux host; missing boundaries remain null
instability_denominator: minimum batch p95; insufficient/near-floor/unstable results are inconclusive
cold_definition: v2: fresh PHP request clients and fresh relevant request-path workers per wave; unrelated background queue workers stay warm. Reset icons/catalog projection caches but preserve canonical intent caches. Source queue names, sleeps and durability unchanged; not OS/page-cache/image/DB cold
cold_interpretation: Separate diagnostic distribution; never pooled with warm and never qualified against the primary minimum
protocol_cutover: Version 4 replaces the staged 140-case plan with 24 current-PHP navigation cases, two batches of 25 attempts and five excluded warmups. Historical runs retain their identity and are never pooled. Small current-PHP transaction/navigation smoke is separate.
cell_chronology: Migrate fresh and seed once per dataset in disposable PostgreSQL; clone pristine p04_seed_small or p04_seed_large outside measurement before each independent cell/batch. Primary warmup and measurement share that clone without reseeding. Diagnostics require no warmup phase; existing cold/warm request-context setup remains unchanged. Flush only local Redis and verify/admit the exact cloned seed before restoring its marker
checkpoint_policy: Atomic fsync checkpoints for every phase and run manifest. Resume requires exact protocol and source hashes, recovers the active durable spool before any reset, rebuilds journals without duplicate identities, skips completed cells and preserves interrupted attempts under their original batch number
redis_sensor_semantics: ready excludes Laravel :notify wakeup-token lists; reserved/delayed are separate sorted-set cardinalities; wakeup_tokens is separate and never called job backlog
current_profile: unchanged Laravel business path and source-configured nine queue workers/sleeps; CLI HTTP-kernel ingress, not Nginx/FPM or production capacity
normalized_profile: same queues and durability under P01 equal aggregate cap, explicit queue-sleep normalization; never pooled with current
background_policy: Per wave create one fresh pending verification Order and one expired notification Order through normal owners; enqueue one real verification job and one real notification job. Never depend on aging historical payments for work supply. Record volume, population growth and drain accounting

unavailable_evidence.sandbox_provider: not run; separate P01/P08 target qualification
unavailable_evidence.live_testing_bot: not run; requires attested safe targets
